name: Tailor a job application to real evidence
why: Matches a resume to a job post using only what the person really did, the same rule as the tailored CV skill.

name: Job application evidence review assistant
why: Checks every claim in a tailored resume and answers against the person's record before they apply.

name: Elevator pitch writer
why: Writes 10, 30 and 60 second pitches, a starting point for 'Tell me about yourself' and networking.

name: Negotiation call prep planner
why: Plans a hard call with an opening and questions, useful before the offer and pay talk.

name: Pay raise case builder
why: Builds the case and script for a pay rise from the person's results, matching the offer and pay talk skill.

name: Honest appreciation note writer
why: Writes a short, specific thank-you note from meeting notes, for after interviews and networking calls.

name: Resignation letter writer
why: Writes a short resignation letter, what to say first and a handover list once a new offer is in writing.

name: Job exit plan writer
why: Plans leaving a job to go out on your own: notice letter, who to tell first and an income check.

name: Leave a steady job and earn from your own work
why: A full run for people moving from a salary to their own clients, often paired with a freelance profile.

name: X and LinkedIn post pair writer
why: Turns one idea into a LinkedIn post that sounds like the person, after the profile is rewritten.

name: Make a strong first impression and build the relationship
why: Prepares a brief and plan before meeting someone new, useful for networking conversations during a search.
